method: Codex visual comparison of all 29 correspondence-bearing PDF pages across the outer and nested review passes, using native UTF-8 text and exact page hashes. Same-assistant editorial review, not independent verification.

reviews.notes: Header labels are separated from subject/date values: native lines 6 and 7 belong to the source header, not authored body. Native line 8 is the forwarding note, 9-11 signature, and 12-20 a quoted message. Subject native text differs from the visible source; no repair or identity assignment.
